# QueryAPIGate

> One governed gate between your databases and everything that asks them for data: saved SQL published as REST endpoints, MCP tools for AI agents, live events and scheduled exports, with identity, grants, parameter validation, masking and an audit record on every call. Self-hosted, Python, Apache-2.0.

Site: https://anantharajuc.github.io/QueryAPIGate-website/
Repository: https://github.com/AnanthaRajuC/QueryAPIGate
Everything below in one file: https://anantharajuc.github.io/QueryAPIGate-website/llms-full.txt
